note: Same inference from the bound on m to a bound on g, but via termwise bounds on S_d with weights H_d, not via F_v(s1,s2,x).

/-- **`|S_d(N/d)| ≤ 0.03 d^{1/9} P_{1/9}(d)/log x + √2 √d P_{1/2}(d)/√x`**. -/
theorem abs_Sd_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) {d : ℕ} (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) :
    |Sd d (⌊x⌋₊ / d)| ≤ 0.03 * (d : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x * PS (1 / 9) d (⌊x⌋₊ / d) +
      √2 * √(d : ℝ) / √x * PS (1 / 2) d (⌊x⌋₊ / d) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd1
  rw [Sd_eq]
  refine (abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
  have hterm : ∀ a ∈ Icc 1 (⌊x⌋₊ / d),
      |Hd d a * ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 (⌊x⌋₊ / d / a), (μ b : ℝ) / b| ≤
        0.03 * (d : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x * (Hd d a * (a : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9)) +
        √2 * √(d : ℝ) / √x * (Hd d a * (a : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) := by
    intro a ha
    have ha1 := (mem_Icc.1 ha).1
    have haN := (mem_Icc.1 ha).2
    have hda : d * a ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := by
      rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hd1] at haN; rw [mul_comm]; exact haN
    have hu1 : 1 ≤ d * a := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega))
    have hux : ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x :=
      (by exact_mod_cast hda : ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ⌊x⌋₊).trans (Nat.floor_le hx0.le)
    have hfl : ⌊x⌋₊ / d / a = ⌊x / ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊ := by
      rw [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, Nat.floor_div_natCast]
    have hm := abs_m_le hx hu1 hux
    rw [← hfl] at hm
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Hd_nonneg d a)]
    have ha0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a := Nat.cast_nonneg a
    have e1 : ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) =
        (d : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) * (a : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) := by
      push_cast; exact Real.mul_rpow hd0.le ha0
    have e2 : √((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) = √(d : ℝ) * (a : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
      push_cast; rw [Real.sqrt_mul hd0.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (a : ℝ)]
    rw [e1, e2] at hm
    calc Hd d a * |∑ b ∈ Icc 1 (⌊x⌋₊ / d / a), (μ b : ℝ) / b|
        ≤ Hd d a * (0.03 * ((d : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) * (a : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9)) / Real.log x +
          √2 * (√(d : ℝ) * (a : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) / √x) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (Hd_nonneg d a)
      _ = _ := by ring
  refine (sum_le_sum hterm).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, ← mul_sum]
  rfl

proof_context.conclusion: |S_d(N/d)| ≤ 0.03 d^{1/9} P_{1/9}(d)/log x + √2 √d P_{1/2}(d)/√x, from abs_m_le termwise.

/-- `|g₂(x)| ≤ ∑_{d ≤ N} f(d)² S_d(N/d)²`. -/
theorem abs_g2_le_sum (x : ℝ) :
    |g2 x| ≤ ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, fo d ^ 2 * Sd d (⌊x⌋₊ / d) ^ 2 := by
  rw [g2_eq_sum_moebius]
  refine (abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (sum_le_sum fun d _ => ?_)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (fo d)),
    abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (Sd d (⌊x⌋₊ / d))), mul_assoc]
  have : |(μ d : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one
  calc |(μ d : ℝ)| * (fo d ^ 2 * Sd d (⌊x⌋₊ / d) ^ 2) ≤ 1 * (fo d ^ 2 * Sd d (⌊x⌋₊ / d) ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this (by positivity)
    _ = _ := one_mul _

proof_context.conclusion: g₂ is bounded by the sum over d of f(d)² S_d² terms.
